usedFor: Bigin holds small-business contacts, and HubSpot receives them when “New Contact Created” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Created” in Bigin, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Contacts added in Bigin appear in HubSpot as they are created, so marketing and sales share one list.

watchOut: “Create Contact” in HubSpot requires an email, so Bigin contacts saved without one will not come through.
